items.title: Serving tenants, landlords & property managers across the GTA
Insured, uniformed crews experienced in condo & apartment buildings

c: Clearing out a property after an eviction can be overwhelming, but Live Junk Free makes it simple. We provide fast, affordable eviction cleanout services for landlords, property managers, and homeowners across the Greater Toronto Area. Whether you’re handling a tenant eviction or prepping for a sale, our expert team removes all unwanted items quickly and respectfully.

We understand the stress that comes with eviction situations. That’s why our team arrives on time, handles every step with care, and makes sure the space is left tidy. From furniture and trash to appliances and clutter, we take it all.

blocks.text: Call Now or Book Online – Transparent Pricing, No Surprises

Our Cleanout Service Is So Hassle-Free, You’ll Be Amazed!

items: We handle eviction cleanouts in any property, whether it’s a cluttered apartment, a packed-up house, or a commercial space. Our team efficiently clears out all unwanted items while respecting the property’s condition.

From old furniture and appliances to piles of debris and personal belongings, we take care of it all. We handle the hauling, and proper disposal, so you don’t have to worry about anything. When we’re done, the property will be tidy and ready for its next chapter.
